Lead with what an alternative AI governance bloc would actually contain, because that is the test: compute access, model weights, data-localisation rules and export licensing are the four levers, and a 'community' that does not move any of them is a communiqué. Mechanism our reader needs, stated as arithmetic: the countries Xi is addressing — Indonesia, Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Brazil, India — cannot train frontier models because the accelerators are made by one company, fabricated by one foundry, and licensed by one government, so 'open ecosystem' in practice means access to Chinese open-weight models and Chinese hardware, which substitutes one dependency for another. Say that plainly rather than treating the offer as either liberation or propaganda. Report what was actually agreed and what the New Delhi Declaration text says on AI, what China has already delivered on this front (open-weight releases, the Global AI Governance Initiative, data-centre finance in the Gulf and Southeast Asia), and where it sits against the UN and OECD processes. Then the stakes: whether a state can build on open weights it did not train and cannot audit is the sovereignty question behind all of this. Multi-source — Bloomberg (US), TASS (RU) and NDTV (IN), sentiment divergence 0.27; note the spread between them and use it, since each is reporting a different audience's version of the same speech. Distinct from our 09-13 piece on Modi and critical-mineral chokepoints: that was the supply chain, this is the rulebook. Do not re-argue the chokepoint case.

stories.label: I fixed a tractor using John Deere's self-repair service. Farmers aren't sold on it.
stories.summary: A reporter with no mechanical training reconnected a water-in-fuel sensor on a John Deere tractor using the company's own customer service ADVISOR software — and farmers still say the self-repair offering does not give them what they need. Lead with the gap between the demonstration and the demand, because that gap is the mechanism: Deere's concession lets an owner diagnose and clear a fault, but the parts that matter are gated behind serial-code pairing, where a replacement component must be authorised against the machine's identity before it will run — so the repair is permitted and the part is not. Explain serial-code pairing plainly; our reader will recognise it instantly as the same technique that binds a phone screen or a printer cartridge, arriving on a $500,000 asset that a harvest depends on. Report what the 2023 memorandum of understanding with the American Farm Bureau actually obliged Deere to do, what the FTC action alleges, which US states have passed agricultural right-to-repair laws and what they exempt, and what a dealer callout costs against an owner's own hour. Then the part no US review carries, and it is why this belongs in our feed: the second-hand market for pre-electronic Deere machinery has become a global one, and mechanics in Punjab, the Nile Delta, Ukraine and the Brazilian cerrado maintain these tractors with jailbroken Ukrainian-sourced diagnostic firmware because there is no authorised dealer within a day's drive — a repair monopoly enforced by software is, outside North America, simply a machine that stops. Cost it: what an idle tractor costs a smallholder during a two-week planting window. Ars Technica is a reader-aligned source with hands-on original reporting; attribute the demonstration to it and get the farmers' side from named growers, not trade associations.

stories.label: Researchers pinpoint key early-universe measurement with record precision
stories.summary: An international team including the University of Minnesota has measured the primordial helium abundance — the helium forged in the universe's first five minutes — with unprecedented accuracy. Lead with the five minutes, because the reason this measurement matters is that it is a direct observational check on physics from an epoch nothing else reaches: Big Bang nucleosynthesis converted protons and neutrons into helium-4, deuterium and lithium in a window that closed before the universe was old enough to have a first birthday in any useful sense, and the ratio it left behind is frozen in. Mechanism our technically literate reader will enjoy: the helium fraction depends almost entirely on the neutron-to-proton ratio at freeze-out, which depends on the expansion rate, which depends on how many relativistic particle species were present — so a precise helium number is, concretely, a count of neutrino species and a bound on any light particle nobody has found yet. That is the payoff, and it should be stated as such: a measurement of a gas ratio is a constraint on undiscovered physics. Report how the measurement was made (which metal-poor emission-line galaxies, which telescope, which lines), the value and its error bar against the previous best, and where it sits relative to the Standard Model prediction and to the CMB-derived baryon density — agreement is a result and tension is a bigger one, so say which this is. Name the institutions and the journal, and be honest about what the systematic uncertainties are, since in this measurement they have historically dominated the statistical ones. Avoid 'rewrites our understanding' register entirely; this is precision, not revolution, and the precision is the point.

stories.label: Quality and reliability of cancer pain management information on short-video platforms in China: a cross-sectional content analysis
stories.summary: A cross-sectional analysis scores the quality and reliability of cancer-pain management videos on Chinese short-video platforms, using established instruments (report which — JAMA benchmark, DISCERN, GQS). Lead with the measured result, not the worry: give the actual scores, what share of videos came from clinicians versus patients versus commercial accounts, and which content type scored worst — because the finding readers can use is the ranking, not the alarm. Mechanism, and this is why the study is not a scold about the internet: cancer pain is undertreated worldwide for a specific structural reason, which is that opioid prescribing is tightly restricted and clinician training in pain management is thin, so patients in pain go looking — the short-video feed is filling a gap left by a health system, and the information quality is downstream of the prescribing regime, not of the platform. Say what China's opioid access actually looks like and how it compares to the global picture, in which a very large majority of the world's morphine is consumed by a small minority of its population. Report the study's design honestly: a content analysis scores presentation quality, it does not measure whether any patient was harmed or helped, and the piece must not overclaim — say what the authors themselves flag as limitations, and note this is an accepted manuscript with a DOI rather than the version of record. Then the structural why for our reader, who is unlikely to live in China: the same dynamic runs on Arabic, Urdu and Bahasa short-video platforms, where palliative care provision is thinner still and engagement algorithms reward confident answers over careful ones — a video that says 'take this' outperforms a clinician saying 'it depends' by construction. Who is affected: people in pain at the end of life, and the families making decisions for them.

stories.label: Indonesia rescuers search for 140 people from stricken ferry
stories.summary: The KM Virgo Transport 8 left Surabaya for Banjarmasin carrying 243 people and lost contact in the Java Sea early Sunday in bad weather; one confirmed dead, about 140 still missing, 103 evacuated per Antara. Lead with the manifest against the rescue count, because the gap is the story and the manifest itself is usually the first thing that turns out to be wrong — Indonesian ferry casualty figures routinely rise when unticketed passengers are counted. Mechanism for the reader: Indonesia is 17,000 islands with no alternative to sea transport for ordinary people, so ferry safety is not a transport question but an access question — overloading, ageing hulls and weather-window pressure are the predictable output of a route that must sail because there is no other way to get to Kalimantan. Report the vessel's age, class, operator and licensed capacity, what the Surabaya port authority cleared it to carry, what BMKG had forecast, and how long it took SAR to reach the position. Then the accountability layer: Indonesia's transport ministry has promised the same reforms after Tanjung Priok, after the Sewol-era audits, after the 2018 Lake Toba sinking — name what was promised and what was done. Who is affected: working-class inter-island passengers and migrant workers, not tourists. Indonesia is an OIC member and Antara News (ID) is in the cluster — use it for the domestic figures rather than resting on DW and US News, since the national agency has the SAR and Basarnas numbers first. NOTE: the feed contained a second cluster for this same event mis-titled 'Altman Says OpenAI Will Not Go Public in 2026' (eng-12005379, Bloomberg) — the Bloomberg URL is genuine ferry reporting and is merged into sources here; the two clusters are one event. Fills the audit's flagged Southeast Asia gap, which had been absent outright.

stories.label: Protest continues in Karachi as family refuses to bury teen until his killers are arrested
stories.summary: Six robbers, two of them in police uniforms, entered Roidad Hussain's house in Manghopir on 8 September and shot his teenage son dead; five days on the family will not bury him until the killers are arrested, and a DIG has confirmed the protest. Lead with the unburied body, because in Islamic practice burial is owed within a day — a family that holds a funeral open for five days is making the only sanction available to people the state will not answer. Mechanism, and this is the systemic point rather than a crime brief: the two police uniforms are the whole case. Karachi's uniform supply is unregulated and open-market, and the uniform works as a weapon precisely because a household opens the door to it — so the question for the Sindh police is not only who fired but who can buy the uniform, and whether any serving officer was involved, which is the allegation the family is actually making. Report the boy's name, what the FIR says and when it was registered, which police station, whether any arrest has followed, and what the DIG and the Edhi Foundation have said. Then the structural why: Manghopir is a peripheral, largely Pashtun and Baloch working-class katchi abadi, the part of Karachi where policing is thinnest and extortion densest, and the class geography of who gets an investigation is the reason this protest exists. Pakistan is an OIC member and Dawn (PK) is the regional outlet doing the original reporting — attribute to it throughout. Do not write this as a crime story; write it as a story about what recourse looks like when there is none.

stories.label: US court blocks Trump administration plan to cut disaster agency workforce
stories.summary: US District Judge Susan Illston ruled on Friday that DHS acted unlawfully in ordering job cuts at FEMA. Lead with the legal finding, not the politics: a court has held that the executive cannot dismantle a congressionally created agency by staffing decision. Mechanism, and it is the precedent our reader should take: Congress appropriates for an agency and sets its statutory duties, but the executive controls hiring, so a reduction-in-force is the instrument by which an administration can nullify a law it cannot repeal — Illston's ruling tests whether that instrument is reviewable, and she is the same judge who has now blocked this manoeuvre across several agencies. Report what the order actually does (injunction scope, which positions, whether cuts already executed are reversed), the statutory hook she relied on, and what the administration's appeal path is. Then the consequence, which is not abstract: FEMA is the agency that staffs disaster declarations, and hurricane season is running — report current staffing against the pre-cut baseline and against the number of open declarations. Accountability: name the DHS officials who ordered it. This is the 'single court ruling with precedent' case, not a news-cycle item — keep it on the mechanism of nullification-by-staffing, which is a pattern our readers will meet again in their own states. Al Jazeera (QA) is a reader-aligned source and is the only one in the feed cluster; the story is US-domestic so no OIC regional source applies.

stories.label: Number of local coalitions to rise steeply after 4 November
stories.summary: Susan Booysen, Wits professor emeritus, projects South Africa's hung municipalities rising from 88 to about 110 at the 4 November local elections. Lead with the two numbers, because a country where a quarter of its municipalities are governed by coalition has quietly changed its constitutional form without amending anything. Mechanism for the reader, and it is the part every horse-race story omits: South African local government uses proportional representation with no threshold and no coalition-formation rules, so a council of fifty can seat a party holding one seat, and that one seat can price a mayoralty — which is why Johannesburg has churned through mayors at a rate that makes budget execution impossible and why refuse, water and electricity delivery degrade fastest in exactly the metros with the most fragmented councils. Coalition instability is not a political inconvenience; it is a service-delivery mechanism with a body count in cholera and water outages. Report the current 88 by province, the ANC's projected share, and what the Municipal Structures Act does and does not say about coalition agreements — there is draft legislation on thresholds, so say where it stands. Then give the reader the comparative frame: this is the same arithmetic that produced Sweden's kingmaker problem, which we reported this morning, arriving in a state with far less fiscal slack to absorb it. Attribute the projection to Booysen and Daily Maverick as a forecast, not a finding. This is a South African analyst on South African politics and the audit's Africa gap is at two articles, both security — this one is governance and economics, which is what the continent has been missing here for three days.

stories.label: Iran can easily withdraw from NPT, revise nuclear doctrine
stories.summary: Abbas Goudarzi, spokesman for the Iranian parliament's presiding board, said on Sunday that leaving the Non-Proliferation Treaty is 'a readily attainable step' and that trusting the United States amounts to accepting deception. Lead with the institutional source, not the sentiment: this is the Majlis presiding board, the body that would actually carry a withdrawal bill, speaking during a war — which makes it a legislative signal rather than a talking point, and that distinction is the whole value of the story. Mechanism, and it must be precise because almost no coverage gets it right: NPT Article X permits withdrawal on three months' written notice to the other parties and the Security Council, stating the extraordinary events that jeopardised supreme interests — so withdrawal is legal, quick, and the only state ever to do it is North Korea in 2003. What withdrawal actually removes is IAEA safeguards access, meaning the world's ability to observe Iranian enrichment ends before any weapon exists; the inspectors are the thing that leaves, and that is the concrete cost. Explain also what Iran's current doctrine is — Khamenei's fatwa against nuclear weapons is the stated basis, so 'revising the doctrine' is a religious-legal claim as much as a strategic one, and our reader will want that treated seriously rather than waved at. Report what the Majlis has actually passed or tabled to date, what the IAEA's present access is, and what Araghchi and the foreign ministry say, since parliament and the ministry have diverged on this before. Iran is an OIC member and Mehr (IR) is the domestic agency reporting its own parliament — attribute plainly to Mehr as the source of a named official's statement, do not upgrade a spokesman's remark into state policy, and seek corroboration from IRNA or Tehran Times. Distinct from our 09-12 Trump-claims and 09-13 Hormuz diplomacy pieces: this is the treaty architecture, not the war or the waterway.

stories.label: Soldiers arrest three suspects after 17-year-old was killed in Plateau
stories.summary: Peter Gyang, 17, was killed at Kafi-Abu village in Barkin Ladi, Plateau State, and troops acting on intelligence arrested three suspects at a nearby settlement on Saturday. Lead with the name and the place, because Barkin Ladi is not a random location — it is the epicentre of the Plateau killings, where hundreds died in 2018 and where attacks have continued through every commission of inquiry since. Mechanism, and it is what makes this a governance story rather than a crime report: soldiers, not police, made the arrests, because Nigeria's Middle Belt has been under a standing military operation for years — Operation Safe Haven — and a state that polices with the army has replaced investigation with occupation. Soldiers can detain; they cannot build a prosecutable case, which is why the conviction record for Plateau killings is close to nothing across a decade of arrests. Report who the three are, whether they have been transferred to police custody or the DSS, and what happened to those arrested after the previous Barkin Ladi attacks — that follow-up is the story. Then the structural why for our reader: the farmer–herder framing exported to the world hides a land-tenure conflict over grazing corridors, indigene-settler citizenship rules that deny some Plateau residents state rights by birth, and a climate signal pushing pastoralists south — name those, and do not let a Muslim-versus-Christian frame stand in for them. Nigeria is an OIC member and Premium Times (NG) is the regional outlet with original reporting; attribute throughout. Second Africa entry against a gap the audit has flagged for three days.

stories.label: The Outlook Is Getting Grimmer By The Day For Oil Exports From The Red Sea
stories.summary: With Iraqi militia drones striking the Saudi East–West pipeline and Ansarallah now holding the positions that command Bab al-Mandab, every route out of Gulf and Red Sea oil is under one of two guns. Write the export map as arithmetic, not as a war narrative. Lead with the count: Saudi crude has exactly three ways to reach a buyer — Hormuz, the East–West pipeline to Yanbu and then Bab al-Mandab, and the Gulf terminals themselves — and this week is the first time all three have been simultaneously contested. Mechanism our reader should keep: a hedge is worth nothing if the failure modes correlate, and correlation is what has just happened, because one adversary coalition can now reach the launch point for each. Report the hard numbers rather than the atmosphere — East–West throughput capacity and current flow, Yanbu loadings, transits through Bab al-Mandab this week against the 2023 baseline, Brent and Dubai, and the war-risk premium as a percentage of hull value on each of the three routings, which is the figure that actually decides whether a charterer sails. Then the part Western defence coverage never carries: the countries that lose first are not the buyers but the importers with no strategic reserve and a dollar-denominated fuel bill — Pakistan, Egypt, Bangladesh, Kenya — where a sustained freight and insurance step-up becomes a currency and subsidy crisis within a quarter. Name them and cost it. This is the third and final entry in the pipeline arc (after 09-12 Ankara and 09-13 Maysan) — it is the consolidated economics, so do not re-tell the launcher seizure or the shutdown. SOURCING: The War Zone is single-source and US defence-trade; the writer must verify the Bab al-Mandab and pipeline claims against Lloyd's List, Reuters, EIA or TankerTrackers, and should seek Arab News (SA), Al Jazeera (QA) or Mehr (IR) for the regional read — the feed offers no OIC-region outlet on this specific analysis, which is a feed-side gap worth auditing given Saudi Arabia, Yemen and Iraq are the subjects.

stories.label: Crafts from 100 Pakistani villages on display under one roof at Karachi Expo Centre
stories.summary: The 25th Daachi Arts and Crafts Exhibition opened at the Karachi Expo Centre with about 200 stalls carrying work from more than 100 villages — Hala and Multan pottery, Sindhi and Balochi embroidery, ralli quilts. Do not write a culture listing; write the market-access problem it exists to solve. Lead with the distance the goods travelled and what that distance normally costs: a Hala potter or a Tharparkar embroiderer sells through middlemen who take the margin because the producer has no route to a buyer, and a two-day fair is a temporary substitute for a distribution channel that the sector does not have the rest of the year. Mechanism for our reader, which is the structural why: Pakistani handicraft is overwhelmingly home-based female labour, unregistered, uncounted in GDP and outside the labour code — so 'informal' here means no contract, no minimum piece rate and no bargaining position, and the reason craft exports stay small is not demand abroad but the absence of aggregation, certification and freight at the producer end. Report the real economics — what an embroiderer is paid per piece against the Expo Centre retail price, Pakistan's annual handicraft export figure and its trend, what TDAP and SMEDA actually fund, and whether any of the 100 villages sell online or through a cooperative. Then the comparison that makes the point land: India's and Morocco's craft-export programmes are built on artisan registries and geographical-indication marks, and Pakistan's are not — say what that costs. Quote artisans by name, especially women, rather than organisers. Pakistan is an OIC member and Dawn (PK) is the regional source. This is the audit's flagged absence of any non-conflict economy story from Asia or Africa — treat it as economics, and the register must be sober, not celebratory.

stories.label: Xi by his side, Modi warns against 'weaponisation of tech'
stories.summary: At the New Delhi BRICS summit, with Xi Jinping beside him, Modi asked the bloc to recognise the danger of weaponising 'technology and critical minerals'. Lead with who is standing next to whom, because the sentence is aimed in two directions at once and the staging is the reporting: China holds the chokepoint Modi is describing. Write the supply chain, not the summit — we have covered this summit three times and will not cover it again. Mechanism, concretely: China refines roughly nine-tenths of the world's rare earths and holds near-monopoly positions in gallium, germanium and graphite processing, and export-licensing controls on those inputs are now a routine instrument of Chinese statecraft — while the United States runs the mirror-image instrument in the Entity List and the chip-tooling controls that reach any fab using American equipment anywhere. Both are 'weaponisation', and Modi named neither. That is the story: a summit communiqué against chokepoint coercion signed by the two states that own the chokepoints. Report the actual dependency figures with sources, India's own position (it has export-restricted some minerals and is building a rare-earth magnet scheme), and what the declaration text says as against what it omits. Then the stakes for our reader: Indonesia, Malaysia, Turkey and the Gulf are building semiconductor, EV and battery capacity on inputs they do not control, so a licence regime in Beijing or Washington sets the ceiling on industrial policy in Jakarta and Ankara — that is technological sovereignty stated as an arithmetic, and it is why this belongs in tech rather than diplomacy. Multi-source: NDTV and Rediff (both IN), sentiment divergence 0.35. No OIC-region outlet covered this specific event angle in the feed, though Dawn (PK) carried the separate BRICS restraint declaration — note that as a feed-side gap.

stories.label: Beyond full fine-tuning: towards enhanced generalizability in downstream ECG foundation model adaptation
stories.summary: Researchers report that fully fine-tuning an ECG foundation model on a downstream task generalises worse than lighter adaptation methods — the model learns the hospital, not the heart. Lead with that failure mode, because it is the one thing clinicians and engineers both need and neither is told: full fine-tuning on a single site's recordings overwrites the general representation with local artefacts — that site's electrode placement, lead noise, patient mix and device vendor — so the model posts a better score on held-out data from the same hospital and degrades on anyone else's. Mechanism for our reader: parameter-efficient adaptation (LoRA, adapters, linear probing — say which the paper tested) freezes most of the pretrained weights and trains a small number, which structurally limits how much local idiosyncrasy the model can absorb; the constraint is the feature. Report the actual evidence — the datasets and how many sites, in-distribution versus out-of-distribution accuracy for each method, the number of trainable parameters, and whether the gains hold on the arrhythmia classes that are rare and clinically dangerous rather than on aggregate AUC. Then the structural why, which is the reason this belongs in our feed: ECG is the cheapest diagnostic in cardiology and the one most likely to be automated first in health systems with few cardiologists — Pakistan, Egypt, Nigeria, Indonesia — and those systems will deploy models pretrained on North American and European cohorts with local data too scarce for full fine-tuning. A method that adapts well on little data is a health-access fact before it is an ML result; a model that silently learns one hospital is a harm exported. Accepted manuscript with a DOI, not the version of record — say so, and name the authors and institutions.

stories.label: Effects of heat exposure on self-reported heat strain symptoms among pregnant and postpartum women in South Africa
stories.summary: A cohort study in South Africa finds that 14-day average outdoor wet-bulb globe temperature and maximum air temperature are both consistently associated with heat strain symptoms in pregnant and postpartum women, and the associations survive adjustment for covariates. Lead with the fourteen days, because the exposure window is the finding: this is not heatstroke on a record afternoon, it is cumulative load over a fortnight, which means the risk is invisible to every warning system built around single-day thresholds. Mechanism, explained plainly and it is genuinely interesting physiology: pregnancy already runs a raised metabolic rate, expanded plasma volume and a redistributed cardiac output that sends blood to the placenta, so a pregnant woman has less thermoregulatory reserve to spend on skin perfusion and sweating — heat and pregnancy compete for the same circulatory capacity, and the fetus has no independent way to shed heat. Say what the downstream outcomes in the wider literature are (preterm birth, low birthweight, stillbirth) and be careful to mark which this study measured and which it did not. Report the numbers: cohort size, setting, effect estimates per degree, and what WBGT is and why it differs from the temperature on a phone — it folds humidity, radiant heat and wind, which is exactly why it catches what a thermometer misses. Then who is affected and how, concretely: women doing outdoor agricultural or informal work in Limpopo and Mpumalanga, in homes with metal roofs and no cooling, who cannot take a fortnight off — the intervention that follows from a 14-day exposure window is work scheduling and shade, not an emergency alert. This is African science about African women, from a South African cohort, against an audit gap of two Africa articles in three days, both of them security. Name the institutions and the cohort.

stories.label: A multimodal murmuration for immunotherapy
stories.summary: A Nature Medicine piece arguing that predicting who benefits from cancer immunotherapy requires many weak signals read together — imaging, pathology, genomics, circulating markers — rather than the single biomarker the field has spent a decade looking for. Lead with the failure that motivates it: PD-L1 expression and tumour mutational burden are the biomarkers in clinical use, and they are poor enough that most patients given a checkpoint inhibitor do not respond while carrying its real toxicity and its very large price. Mechanism, and the metaphor in the title is the argument: a murmuration has no leader — the behaviour is a property of the interactions, and the claim here is that immunotherapy response is likewise a system state, not a molecule, so combining modalities recovers signal that no single assay holds. Explain why that is technically hard rather than merely fashionable: each modality has its own missingness and batch effects, and a multimodal model trained on a few hundred patients will happily learn the scanner. Report what evidence the authors present, whether it is prospective or retrospective, the effect sizes, and the declared conflicts — the corresponding author reports funding from AstraZeneca and Roche and sits on a Roche trial steering committee, which the piece must state, because these are the companies selling the drugs a better biomarker would ration. Then the access point our reader should be given: a multimodal predictor needs an MRI, digitised pathology, a sequencing panel and the informatics to fuse them, so a method that improves patient selection in Barcelona can simultaneously widen the gap for a hospital in Cairo or Lahore where the single cheap assay is all there is — better prediction is not automatically better access. This is a perspective piece, not a trial; label it as argument and attribute throughout.
